description: This file provides utility functions for generating consistent, deterministic colors for statuses and arbitrary strings, tailored for dark backgrounds and dashboards. It defines functions for mapping statuses to theme colors and generating pastel hues from strings.

methods.name: colorFromString(key, { saturation = 55, lightness = 55 } = {})
methods.description: Deterministically generates a pastel-like HSL color from an input string, ensuring distinct colors for different strings while maintaining suitable contrast for dark backgrounds.

methods.name: getStatusColor(status, oc)
methods.description: Maps a given status string to a themed color based on predefined categories; defaults to a deterministic color for unknown statuses.
